title: The two minarets
place: Salah al-Din Square, on the pavement facing the domed tomb end, looking up at the two minarets on either side of the dome.

quiz.q: What was special about the minaret that fell?
options: It had two lanterns at the top
It leaned. Feedback: "It was said to be double-headed."
